notes: Frozen wire contract between app.saive.my (/api/sync/*) and the saive-obsidian plugin.
Both repos hold a copy of this file and assert against it. Change it here first, bump version, then copy it to the plugin repo.
seq and cursor values are decimal strings: change_seq is a Postgres bigint.
markdown is byte-identical to the vault object. Clients write it as-is.
Every entry on a page carries its seq: files, deleted, missing, oversize. nextCursor is at or above every seq on the page, so missing and oversize entries advance the cursor too.
missing: the index row exists and the vault object does not. The client skips it. oversize: the save exceeds the page byte budget. The client fetches it from /api/sync/file/[uuid].
oversize entries also carry folder and title (since 1.1), so a client can place a save it has never seen before the /file body arrives.
folder is null for an unfiled save. Clients place it in the root folder.
